subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support a channel/session-scoped `/agent` switch command that overrides static bindings, and what policy boundary should govern visible agents and workspace/tool access?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses routing, session state, channel commands, workspace isolation, tool authorization, and security policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design guarded session switch
options.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only among authorized configured agents, persists in canonical session state, and enforces existing subagent/sandbox/tool policy.

options.title: Keep static routing plus focus
options.body: Decline a direct configured-agent switch and keep bindings, TUI `/agent`, `agents_list`, `sessions_spawn`, and `/focus` as the supported multi-agent paths.

options.title: Expose a plugin seam first
options.body: Design a generic command/agent-picker SDK seam and let channel plugins implement visible switch UI after the policy contract exists.

recommendation.title: Design guarded session switch
recommendation.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only among authorized configured agents, persists in canonical session state, and enforces existing subagent/sandbox/tool policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for multi-agent routing and agent discovery points to steipete's merged feature work.
